sections.Profile:
The "Soccer" pinball machine, produced by Gottlieb in March 1975, was designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. This electro-mechanical game features a soccer theme and supports two players.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Soccer, Sports, 1970s

- Design: Ed Krynski
- Animation: Ed Krynski
- Art: Gordon Morison
- Animation: Wayne Neyens
- Concept: Wayne Neyens
